environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on EC2 instance behind AWS ALB with CloudFront distribution in front. CloudFront has a Response Headers Policy (ID: managed-policy-67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03) attached which corresponds to the AWS managed 'SecurityHeadersPolicy'. This policy injects a Content-Security-Policy response header with directive values including default-src 'self' and script-src 'self' on ALL origin responses before they reach the client. The CloudFront behavior is configured with Origin Request Policy set to AllViewer and Cache Policy set to CachingDisabled to ensure dynamic content passes through but response headers are always applied. Additionally, the CloudFront distribution has a custom error page configuration that returns a static error page for 4xx/5xx responses. The ALB is configured as a custom origin with HTTPS-only origin protocol policy.

config.infrastructure: CloudFront -> AWS ALB -> EC2 (ECS Fargate task)
config.cloudfront_response_headers_policy: SecurityHeadersPolicy (managed) - applies CSP: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
config.alb_config: internal ALB, not directly accessible from internet
config.network: CloudFront -> internal ALB in private subnet
